H1.statement: SFT then GRPO beats SFT alone on twin confirmed accuracy on readback_test
H1.test: paired difference M4 minus M1, cluster bootstrap, one sided at the BH adjusted level

H2.statement: GRPO raises pass at 1 more than pass at 16
H2.test: on the generated test set, (M3 pass@1 minus M0 pass@1) minus (M3 pass@16 minus M0 pass@16) above zero

H3.statement: the random reward reaches less than a third of the honest gain
H3.test: on dev, (random minus start) divided by (honest minus start) below 1/3, interval by bootstrap

H4.statement: the lenient arm opens a twin gap of at least ten points by its last checkpoint
H4.test: on dev, honest twin confirmed minus lenient twin confirmed at the last checkpoint at least 0.10

H5.detail: not produced: M2, M3, M2 GPU hours, M3 GPU hours
H5.statement: DPO on verified self samples reaches half the GRPO gain at a quarter of the compute
H5.test: (M2 minus M0) at least half of (M3 minus M0) on readback_test, and M2 GPU hours at most a quarter of M3 GPU hours in the run ledger
